request.spec:
Add an audit viewer to the screen: a filter entry, a show button and a list of lines. With the
filter blank it lists every audit line of this sheet exactly as the file holds it, newest first.
With a name in the filter it lists only the lines about that person: those carrying name=<the
name> or person=<the name>, compared as names are compared (case and surrounding spaces ignored).
The viewer reads what the file holds; it is not a second record.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Add an audit viewer to the screen: a filter entry, a show button and a list of lines. With the
filter blank it lists every audit line of this sheet exactly as the file holds it, newest first.
With a name in the filter it lists only the lines about that person: those carrying name=<the
name> or person=<the name>, compared as names are compared (case and surrounding spaces ignored).
The viewer reads what the file holds; it is not a second record.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The audit viewer is on the screen, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

It has a filter box (`audit-filter`), a Show button (`audit-show`) and the list of lines (`audit-line`). The viewer reads the audit file each time Show is pressed and writes nothing itself.

- **Server:** a new route, `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/audit?name=`, in `resources/officefloor/rest/api/sheets/{sheetId}/audit.GET.yml`. The work is done by a new method, `Audit.linesFor`. It returns this sheet's lines exactly as the file holds them, and the responder (`audit/RespondWithAuditLines.java`) puts them newest first.
- **Filter:** with a name typed in, only lines whose `name=` or `person=` value matches are kept. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored, the same way the app already compares person names. A name containing spaces is matched whole.
- **Front end:** the panel is `features/audit/audit.slot.tsx`, placed near the bottom of the sheet. Pressing Show clears the old list while it loads, so two presses with the same result can still be told apart. If the read fails, it shows an `audit-error` message.
